title: NexusDL Sites Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema validating the structure of sites.yaml and user overrides for NexusDL. Enforces strict typing, pattern matching, and enum constraints for all site definitions.

Language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (2 letters) or 'multi' for multilingual sites.

ContentRating.description: Content rating classification following MangaDex/MAL conventions.

ParserClass.description: Fully qualified Python parser class reference in the format 'module.path:ClassName'. Example: 'nexusdl.parsers.fr.sushiscan_net:SushiScanNetParser'.

SiteId.description: Unique identifier for the site. Must be lowercase snake_case, globally unique across all sites.

SiteCapabilities.description: Operational capabilities and limitations of a parser.

supports_search.description: Whether the parser supports text-based manga search.

supports_manga_info.description: Whether the parser can retrieve detailed manga metadata.

supports_chapters.description: Whether the parser can list chapters of a manga.

supports_pages.description: Whether the parser can retrieve page URLs of a chapter.

supports_download.description: Whether the parser allows actual image downloading.

supports_language_filter.description: Whether the parser supports filtering search results by language.

supports_content_rating_filter.description: Whether the parser supports filtering by content rating (Safe, Suggestive, etc.).

requires_auth.description: Whether the site requires authentication (cookies/login) to access content.

requires_cloudflare_bypass.description: Whether the site is protected by Cloudflare or a similar anti-bot system.

requires_javascript_rendering.description: Whether the site requires JavaScript execution to display content (e.g., dynamically loaded images).

max_concurrent_downloads.description: Maximum number of concurrent page downloads allowed for this site.

rate_limit_per_second.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests per second to this site.

min_delay_between_requests.description: Minimum delay in seconds between two consecutive requests.

SiteConfig.description: Complete configuration of a single supported site.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the site.

domains.description: List of domains (primary first, then mirrors/alternatives). At least one domain is required.

parser_class.description: Fully qualified Python class path for the parser implementation.

language.description: Primary language of the site content (ISO 639-1).

adult.description: Whether the site hosts adult (18+) content.

content_rating.description: Default content rating for the site.

capabilities.description: Operational capabilities and limitations of the parser.

default_headers.description: Default HTTP headers to send with every request to this site.

cookies_required.description: List of cookie names required for this site to work (e.g., Cloudflare clearance).

region_locked.description: Whether the site is geo-restricted and requires a proxy/VPN.

allowed_regions.description: List of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the site is accessible (empty = worldwide).

scanlation_group.description: Name of the scanlation group running the site (if applicable).

notes.description: Free-form notes about the site (maintenance status, known issues, etc.).

enabled.description: Whether the site is enabled by default. Can be overridden by user config.

description: Root object containing the version and the list of all supported sites.

version.description: Schema version for forward compatibility. Must follow SemVer.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the last update to the sites configuration.

sites.description: List of all supported site configurations. Each site must have a unique 'id'.
